name: Python, SQL and Data Engineering Foundations
desc: The foundational skills every enterprise data engineer needs before touching a distributed system: idiomatic Python, query-plan-aware SQL, data modelling, REST integration, Git discipline, and the role itself.

lessons.title: REST APIs and Data Integration Patterns
Git and CI-Aware Workflow for Data Pipelines

name: PySpark and Distributed Data Processing
desc: The technical core of the track: how Spark actually executes work across a cluster -- lazy evaluation, transformations vs actions, partitioning and shuffle, join strategies, skew, caching, serialization and the reasoning behind performance decisions. Grounded against Spark 4.x / PySpark 4.2.0 documented behaviour, not assumed from older versions.

lessons.title: DataFrames, Spark SQL and Schema Enforcement
Join Strategies at Scale: Broadcast vs Sort-Merge
Spark Performance Tuning: Caching, Serialization and Executor Sizing

name: Enterprise ETL/ELT, Ingestion and Data Modelling
desc: Batch vs. streaming ingestion design, idempotent re-runnable pipelines, schema evolution and contract management, Slowly Changing Dimensions at scale, data lake vs. warehouse vs. lakehouse, and metadata-driven ingestion frameworks -- all in enterprise banking and transaction-banking scenarios.

lessons.title: Data Lake vs. Data Warehouse vs. Lakehouse
